summary: At the owner's request, c05-17 (eliminate or restrict T and U visas) was sent to a second independent AI review on whether any qualifying action exists. The review found one: H.R. 8628, introduced on 2026-04-30 and referred to the House Judiciary Committee, would repeal the U visa category. The record moved from in progress 25 to proposed 5, because the earlier rating rested on parallel activity that does not change eligibility, and the bill covers part of the recommendation with nothing operative. The page gained an editor-only preview of the fuller enumeration: a second figure, separate from the key-objective headline, that counts key objectives plus further recommendations and leaves out Foreword recommendations that restate chapter objectives. Public visitors see no change until the preview is approved. No key objective changed in this run.
title: Second review of one further recommendation; fuller enumeration preview
